verbalization: The visible evidence suggests a potential relationship between Dl-Anabasine and SK-VLB through a multi-step mechanism. Dl-Anabasine is predicted to target the IgG receptor FcRn large subunit p51, which is known to be a target of the compound (2S)-2-Amino-4-((carboxycarbonyl)amino)butanoic acid. This compound, in turn, is predicted to have a target of SK-VLB. The evidence indicates a chain of interactions where Dl-Anabasine may inhibit the activity of (2S)-2-Amino-4-((carboxycarbonyl)amino)butanoic acid, thereby affecting SK-VLB. The scores suggest a moderate level of confidence in this relationship, but further experimental validation would be necessary to confirm the direct interaction between Dl-Anabasine and SK-VLB. The mechanism involves a target-mediated pathway, where the inhibition of a key intermediate (FcRn p51) could influence the downstream target SK-VLB.
